name: 11693 · Rockaway Bch, NY
findings: ZIP 11693 (Rockaway Bch) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11693 (Rockaway Bch) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
